_about: 3-15, re-authored on the timing build (wave 3a; first authored by the third verifier of step 127, R1).
The idea is the old one, the ticks are rebuilt around three facts of this build: a shot flies 3.2 u a
tick after a 24 u jump, a placed pair is spent by its first traversal (portals.json
consume_on_traverse, so a third portal landing while two stand takes the oldest), and a fall from the
top lasts 17 ticks (4000 u/s^2) and leaves at the speed it entered at.
Ticks 1-272: left to the ramp's top; a portal at (150, 110) (lands on 132) and one on the player there
(tick 135): through it to (150, 106) on the single block (tick 137, that pair is spent). From the block
portals at (175, 100) (lands 165) and (222, 85) (lands 207): a new pair, and knight B, walking left,
goes in at (222, 87) on tick 271 and out above button_1666, wedged on it: the floor gate door_lift_1663
up from 279. The player drops off the block and walks right along the floor, through the gate into
the key's half (x to 412), where a portal needs 96 px from antiportal_1673 and the half to its right
128 px from antiportal_1683.
A portal at (470, 100) (tick 375, lands 406, 110 px from antiportal_1673), back left through the gate
and a portal on the player at (248.8, 204.3) (tick 470): out at (470, 100) on tick 472, down onto the
seesaw, right along it and off its end onto the floor outside both rings (x 799.5).
There: a portal high on the left face of wall04_low_emissive_1688 at (829, 28) (130 px from
antiportal_1683, tick 655, lands 704), one on the floor at (760, 202) (tick 706, lands 712), and 27
ticks later the one under the key at (728, 191) (129 px, tick 733).
Its 72 u shot lands on tick 750, AFTER the walk left into (760, 202) has put the player out at the top
on tick 747 and spent that pair (landing before it would have taken the oldest of the pair).
The fall from the top is 17 ticks; on tick 760, 27 ticks after that tap, a portal on the falling player
at (810.3, 162.9) (any height from 151 to 175 does; it opens on 762 where he is at 162.9): out at
(728, 193) moving up at 933 u/s, the key taken on tick 772 at its own point (a crystal on the way up),
down onto the floor right of the seesaw's end, right to the keyhole (unlocked 835, gone 926), the door.
Every tap holds up to +-1 tick; the walks that set the player's x (487-622, 740-750) hold to +-1 tick,
because the fall and the last tap are timed to his entry into (760, 202) on tick 746.
